children: Colombia's Deputy Energy Minister Armando Cuello said on Wednesday that a tax model used by Argentina to stimulate investment could easily be applied in Colombia.

Speaking at an economic conference in Colombia's capital Bogota, Cuello said Colombia may mirror Argentina's Incentive Regime for Large Investments (RIGI), launched under President Javier Milei, which is aimed at boosting investment in key sectors such as mining and energy.
